name: proof-e2e-regression
about: E2E results decide e2e checks (#195, docs/decisions/2026-10-18-qa-proofs.md). Two app items reach qa with e2e proofs naming specs as e2e/coverage.json does: a's covers the inbox, b's the login page (and a manual look). They wait for a regression run (no proof pass runs them). The approver's 'regression web' runs the stand-in suite: the inbox spec passes, the login spec fails with its screenshot. a is verified by the loop with the report's link; b is reopened at once as a new P2 item with the assertion, the report's link and the screenshot as evidence, and the run's report says which items it decided and shows the reopened item in place of File it.

proof.look: the login page's error text on a phone
